title: Store Update 1.47.0
body:
# Store Update 1.47.0

Greetings, Raiders. Update 1.47.0 is rolling out now, adding two fresh color options for the Riposta Set, an update regarding Fair Play, and several additional fixes and improvements. You'll need to download the update, so be sure to do that before you jump back into the game.

# Highlights:

* Frozen Trail - First Look arrives September 23rd!

* New Camo and White versions of the Riposta Set

* Progress report on our continuing Fair Play work

* Repairs made to the Rawhide Outfit, keyboard input problems, and doors that occasionally turned invisible

* A reminder to sign up for Expedition 5

# Frozen Trail is on the way - watch the First Look!

If you haven't heard yet, tomorrow we're hosting a First Look session covering Frozen Trail and everything arriving with that update. **Join us September 23rd at 10am PDT (7pm CEST)** for an extended preview of our largest update to date. We're eager to hear your reactions. More announcements are coming before October 8th, so keep watching for updates.

# Content and Bug Fixes

## Cosmetic

* Corrected a problem where the Rawhide outfit's headgear stayed visible even after being switched off in Customization.

## Gameplay

* Door blockers no longer generate a duplicate of their mesh on the reverse side of the direction they're applied to.

* Resolved a problem where keyboard input would sometimes quit working after launching the game unfocused or coming back from the background; keyboard controls now respond reliably when the window regains focus.

* Fixed a bug where doors could get out of sync, appearing open to the player even though they were actually shut.

* Corrected an issue that allowed swapping or splitting items to place them in containers they shouldn't fit (for example, forcing non-quick-use items into the belt slot), and added protections against invalid inventory slot indexing.

## Maps

* Fixed lighting problems in Buried City that made it appear too dark or lacking light entirely, improving visibility overall.

* Corrected visual glitches encountered while moving through Riven Tides.

* Fixed incorrect coloring on various world objects, restoring the proper look of items such as red lockers, toolboxes, office chairs, cars, chests, and shipping containers.

## Performance

* Fixed an issue where inventory item tooltips retained information from prior screens, which was increasing memory usage over time and hurting stability during extended play sessions.

## Stability

* Enhanced our crash detection and diagnostic tools.

* Fixed an infrequent crash tied to server shutdown, improving stability overall.

* Resolved an Xbox-specific issue that could trigger resource conflicts.

* Fixed a common PS5 crash linked to the physics engine.

* Improved the stability of opening the Inventory screen.

## UI

* The Expedition Project button now shows when an Expedition has paused following its cutoff date, and blocks players from committing further resources in that case.

* The default method for assigning Skill Points in the Skill Tree is now hold-to-assign.

# A Brief Update on Fair Play Efforts

While our development team focuses on finishing touches for Frozen Trail, our Anti-Cheat team continues to make ongoing updates and improvements to our Fair Play initiatives.

Regarding economy manipulation, we've carried out several ban waves targeting accounts showing "bot-like" behavior. We'll keep refining our detection methods to catch a wider range of suspicious activity (including XP farming) going forward. We're also continuing to penalize unusually high-value item transfers. Item duplication remains a focus area too, and we're seeing encouraging results from the improvements made throughout this summer.

We're continually developing methods to stop repeat cheaters and keep them from coming back. We are currently reinforcing our policies around shared licenses and how they get restricted once an account has been sanctioned. In practice, this makes it more difficult for someone banned on one account to simply buy another. Monitoring a cheater's behavior both before and after a sanction helps us predict future actions and respond more quickly.

We've said before that acting quickly against unfair play matters a great deal to us. With that goal in mind, we've upgraded our detection systems and are now applying permanent bans on the first offense in more cases. This lets us identify and remove offenders faster, with a high level of confidence in each case.

As we keep refining and expanding how we protect fairness on Topside, thank you for your help in reporting players and flagging any suspicious behavior you encounter.

# Reminder - Claim your Rubber Ducks!

Attention: starting **October 8th**, the inbox message containing the community-made Rubber Ducks will stop being sent out. **Be sure to log in and grab yours before that date arrives.** Don't miss your chance at these fantastic ducks!

# Expedition 5 - Departure Window closes September 29th

Be sure to wrap up your Expedition project and register for Departure prior to September 29th at 10am CEST / 8am UTC / 1am PT. Note that **there is no Last Call** this time, so plan accordingly.

We're aware some of you are running into trouble with the Departure screen. If you can't confirm your sign-up for departure, please contact support right away. Support contact information is available through the game's help resources.

# Known Issues

* We're rolling out several stability fixes aimed at Xbox Series X|S crashes. Please report any ongoing problems to help us with further fixes.

* Further improvements are planned for the Quick Wheel to stop inaccurate switching or "jumping" between item slots.

* The weapon swap animation can look broken if you swap weapons immediately after vaulting.

* Player animations may look broken when a search of the Baron Husk gets interrupted.

* Shredders float up to the ceiling in certain rooms within the Hidden Bunker.

* Leapers are able to jump through the ARC Turbine.

* Shots fired while riding an ARC may fail to register properly.

* The player's character can stutter or jitter after being revived.

* The Matriarch sometimes doesn't use its full range of ranged attacks.

* Footstep sounds go silent during continuous shoulder swapping while sprinting.

* Players can occasionally get stuck on obstacles while sliding downhill.

* Custom keybindings reset after every raid when using keyboard layouts other than US English.

* Long text lists can sometimes vanish while being scrolled through.

See you soon! //Raz
